mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbound_item (outbound_id, inbound_id, quantity) VALUES (#{outboundId}, #{inboundId}, #{quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT oi.item_id, oi.outbound_id, oi.inbound_id, oi.quantity, oi.created_at, i.production_date, i.package_unit_kg, i.size_um FROM outbound_item oi JOIN inbound i ON oi.inbound_id = i.inbound_id WHERE oi.outbound_id = #{outboundId} ORDER BY oi.item_id
